verdict_summary: Buffer Blaster matches AdPanel on single-workspace clarity and self-serve onboarding while substantially exceeding AdPanel on deterministic experiment evaluation, transparent human approval gates before spend, sovereign self-hosted Supabase ledger persistence, and machine-readable Hermes/MCP agent protocols.

remaining_differences.reason: Buffer Blaster focuses on paid media creative generation, sovereign experimentation, and Shopify attribution; inbound social DM workflows are outside core product boundary.
Buffer Blaster is architected for sovereign self-hosted deployment on dedicated VPS infrastructure with multi-worker Redis isolation.
